desc: E11 (m1n1-side, no kernel build): m1n1 always uses tag 0 -> NVMMU TCB slot 0; Linux draws from a pool with reserved_tags=2 so its I/O tag is NON-ZERO. This is one of only four remaining differences after E1-E10 matched nine properties and the fw still asserts. Force a non-zero tag in nvme_exec_command under a compile flag and re-run --wrap-march 200. If m1n1 then asserts at the wrap, the TCB slot index is the trigger and the Linux fix is to pin the I/O tag. Cheap: m1n1 build + chainload only.
